vulnerabilities.title: Reflected input detected
vulnerabilities.description: Controlled input was reflected in the response context.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Response contained the controlled BUGSCANNER_POC marker.
vulnerabilities.exploitation: Safe reproduction only; no active script execution.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Context-aware output encoding and input validation.

vulnerabilities.title: Potential SQL injection
vulnerabilities.description: Response behavior correlated with controlled parameter changes.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Baseline and controlled-marker responses differed consistently.
vulnerabilities.exploitation: Non-destructive verification; no data modification or extraction.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries and server-side validation.

vulnerabilities.title: Authorization boundary requires review
vulnerabilities.description: An object identifier can be changed during an authorized test.
vulnerabilities.evidence: A second test-owned object returned a response under the same identity.
vulnerabilities.exploitation: Safe authorization comparison using test-owned records only.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on every request.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-side URL fetch behavior detected
vulnerabilities.description: The application appears to fetch a controlled callback URL.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Callback event was observed on an organization-controlled endpoint.
vulnerabilities.exploitation: Callback-only proof; no internal addresses or cloud metadata were queried.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Allowlist outbound destinations and restrict server-side URL fetching.
